Two interesting updates around cloud-native[^cloud-native] geospatial in Switzerland:

# CNG Zürich

For 29 October, the Swiss CNG[^cng] community will gather in the Zurich office of Meta from 14:00 to 
21:00 for "talks, demos, and community with (...) practitioners", with a reception starting at 
18:30. For now, there is only a "save-the-date", [more details will follow][cngz]. 

![CNG Forum (source: CNG Forum)](cng-1500x1000.jpg "CNG Forum (source: CNG Forum)")

# KGK-CGC Workshop

On 3 September, the KGK-CGC[^kgk-cgc] held a Technical Workshop. One of the workshop topics was 
cloud-native geospatial. My colleague Stefan Oderbolz and I[^transp], gave a talk about practical 
experience with various cloud-native data formats and how to deploy and use them (and when not to). 
Additionally, specialists from both the [Land Registry and Surveying Office of the Canton of 
Basel-Stadt][bs] and the [Office for Geoinformation of the Canton of Solothurn][so] also presented 
on cloud-native geospatial from their perspectives. To my knowledge, their talks are not public 
(yet? – I will share them here if I get an update). Stefan and I published [our slides][cng-post] 
(in German) as well as a broad [selection of cloud-native geospatial resources][cng-page] (in 
English).

[cngz]: https://cloudnativegeo.org/events/cng-z%C3%BCrich
[bs]: https://www.bs.ch/bvd/grundbuch-und-vermessungsamt
[so]: https://so.ch/verwaltung/bau-und-justizdepartement/amt-fuer-geoinformation/
[cng-post]: https://digital.ebp.ch/2026/09/08/cloud-native-geospatial-vortrag-am-kgk-workshop/
[cng-page]: https://digital.ebp.ch/cng/

[^cloud-native]: I.e., taking full advantage of the cloud computing model; in the data world 
typically through enabling partial downloads of file contents through so-called [HTTP range 
requests](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Range_requests).
[^cng]: Cloud-native geospatial.
[^kgk-cgc]: The Conference of the Cantonal Geoinformation and Cadastral Offices in Switzerland.
[^transp]: Obvious transparency note here.
